newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury gets 10 mln stg back on Texas buy.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury gets 10 mln stg back on Texas buy.

text.p: UK supermarket group J Sainsbury Plc said on Monday that it will receive a repayment of around 10 million stg from Ladbroke Group Plc, following a review of the purchase price of do-it-yourself retailers Texas Homecare Ltd.
Sainsbury bought the Texas Homecare business in March 1995 for a provisional price of 290 million stg.
It said in a statement that the pruchase price included an estimated net asset value of 155 million stg, which was subject to adjustment on finalisation of completion accounts.
In the absence of an agreement, the matter was referred to an independent expert who ruled that there is a balance in favour of Sainburys.
